Definitions for parameters: f1c-OverEUTRA-r16Indicates whether the IAB-MT supports F1-C signalling over DLInformationTransfer and ULInformationTransfer messages via MN when IAB-MT operates in EN-DC mode, as specified in TS 36.331 [17].
scg-DRB-NR-IAB-r16Indicates whether the IAB-MT supports SCG DRB with NR PDCP when IAB-MT operates in EN-DC mode.
interNR-MeasEUTRA-IAB-r16Indicates whether the IAB-MT supports NR measurement and reports while in EUTRA connected and event B1-based measurement and reports while in EUTRA connected.
